name: fast-dev-swarm
description: Ultra-fast development and testing swarm that accelerates feature shipping from concept to merge in minimal cycles.

workers.responsibility: Synthesize minimal, robust technical design and invariants
Implement type-safe API routes, Prisma queries, and validation schemas
Build responsive ADS UI components, Cairo typography, and RTL layouts
Execute tests, typecheck, preflight, and runtime verification

pipelineSteps: 2. Parallel implementation of backend contracts and UI views
3. Run automated verification (pnpm turbo lint typecheck test)
4. Self-heal any failures without prompting user
5. Stage clean git commit and open PR
